relationship.purpose: separate calibration quantity from direct mapping capacity on the D64 teacher-target bypass path
relationship.architecture_line: C68E-repaired repository Residual-MLP at Gaussian sigma=.36

H: The C71E direct 4096-parameter teacher-target mapping fails because of insufficient calibration quantity, insufficient mapping capacity, or an interaction between them. A prospectively locked 2x2 intervention can identify which tested intervention is sufficient to restore the -5 pp task-reference safeguard.
T: Use fresh model seeds 70400-70415 and verification seed 70300. Reproduce the exact C68E robust teacher at sigma=.36. Evaluate four direct teacher-target TinyRes cells: N192/W32 (192 calibration samples, 4096 params; C71 D64 baseline), N384/W32 (calibration-only increase), N192/W64 (capacity-only increase to 8192 params), and N384/W64 (combined). The 384-sample set is nested: the first 192 are exactly the existing seed-20260903 calibration subset, plus 192 non-overlapping extension samples selected prospectively with seed 20260906. The first-192 shifted calibration tensor and validation shift use the same seed rules as C71E D64.
D: First require robust-target validity. Each cell is valid only if its shifted-validation accuracy minus robust-teacher shifted-validation accuracy has paired bootstrap95 lower bound > -5 pp. If the baseline cell is valid, stop because the C71 failure did not reproduce. Otherwise: if combined N384/W64 is invalid while either single-factor cell is valid, stop as nonmonotonic factorial repair; if combined is invalid and neither single-factor cell is valid, report no repair at the tested larger regime; if combined is valid and only N384/W32 is valid, localize a calibration-quantity repair under tested interventions; if combined is valid and only N192/W64 is valid, localize a mapping-capacity repair; if both singles are valid, report both single-factor repairs; if neither single is valid but combined is valid, localize a calibration-capacity interaction repair. All results remain exploratory.
C: Increasing calibration samples may help by improving generalization even with fixed optimization steps, rather than revealing a fundamental sample-complexity threshold.
Increasing width may help via function capacity, optimization conditioning, or both; the experiment identifies a sufficient intervention, not a unique mathematical cause.
The combined cell can be nonmonotonic relative to a single-factor cell because optimization is stochastic and architectures differ; such a result must stop simple localization.
The fresh N192/W32 baseline may be valid even though C71 D64 failed, in which case the prior failure is not reproduced and factorial localization is not justified.
U: The tested calibration sizes 192/384 and widths 32/64 are discrete interventions and do not identify continuous thresholds.
All cells use 600 optimization updates; larger calibration changes sample diversity but not total update count.
Width64 has 8192 trainable scalar parameters because TinyRes uses two bias-free 64-by-width matrices; width32 has 4096.
The -5 pp reference safeguard and -20 pp target safeguard are experiment criteria, not universal constants.
No reduced interface dimension is selected in C72E.

nested_calibration.extension_index_rule: select 192 without replacement from the complement of the base subset using np.random.default_rng(20260906), sorted, then append after the base 192
nested_calibration.nesting_invariant: N192 inputs/targets are exactly the first 192 rows of N384 inputs/targets

N192_W32.role: C71 D64 implementation-equivalent baseline on fresh seeds

mapping_fit.architecture: TinyRes(64,width): x + W2 GELU(W1 x), both Linear layers bias=False
mapping_fit.numeric_initialization_seed_rule: model_seed + 716000 for all cells; architecture shape differs by width
mapping_fit.pairing_rationale: within a width, calibration-size cells share identical initialization; all cells use the same numeric fit RNG seed and the same robust teacher/validation shift

eligibility.eligible_seed_if: robust teacher training and all four direct mappings complete; nested calibration/provenance invariants hold; exact cell parameter counts are 4096/8192; all accuracies/NMSE diagnostics finite and cell NMSE positive

target_task_validity.statistic: paired robust-teacher shifted minus clean validation accuracy
target_task_validity.pass: paired percentile bootstrap95 lower bound > -20 pp

cell_reference_validity.statistic: paired cell shifted-validation accuracy minus robust-teacher shifted-validation accuracy
cell_reference_validity.pass: paired percentile bootstrap95 lower bound > -5 pp

rules: else if target validity fails: STOP_ROBUST_TARGET_INVALID
else if N192_W32 is valid: STOP_C71_BASELINE_FAILURE_NOT_REPRODUCED
else if N384_W64 is invalid and (N384_W32 valid or N192_W64 valid): STOP_NONMONOTONIC_FACTORIAL_REPAIR
else if N384_W64 is invalid and neither single-factor cell is valid: NO_REPAIR_AT_N384_W64
else if N384_W64 valid and N384_W32 valid and N192_W64 invalid: LOCALIZE_CALIBRATION_QUANTITY_REPAIR
else if N384_W64 valid and N384_W32 invalid and N192_W64 valid: LOCALIZE_MAPPING_CAPACITY_REPAIR
else if N384_W64 valid and both single-factor cells valid: BOTH_SINGLE_FACTOR_REPAIRS
else if N384_W64 valid and neither single-factor cell valid: LOCALIZE_CALIBRATION_CAPACITY_INTERACTION_REPAIR

bootstrap.method: paired model-seed percentile95; one common bootstrap index matrix reused for target, all cell validity gates and descriptive paired contrasts

analysis_boundary.scope: exact C72E direct robust-teacher mapping factorial at sigma=.36

the tested factor level is a universal minimum
